source: POD-4837 probe: scratch GROK_HOME, a local fake OpenAI-compatible model server with a dummy key
selection: Complete wire frames of one session: initialize, session/new, session/set_mode, four session/prompt requests carrying _meta.promptId (a plain turn; a tool call with session/request_permission and its answer; a turn cancelled mid-stream by session/cancel; the first promptId again), every update, queue ack and prompt reply; then a second process loading the session (session/load and its replay).
redactions: The probe scratch directory is rewritten to /tmp/grokprobe. Grok's session/setup, MCP and session-list side channels and the available-command inventory are not selected.
